title: Recharge Sync to Meter — SLA Monitoring

panels.title: SLA 30-Min Compliance (Target ≥90%)
panels.description: % of recharges (with commands) synced within 30 min. NO_COMMAND cases excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_30min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30'

panels.title: SLA 60-Min Compliance (Target ≥99%)
panels.description: % of recharges (with commands) synced within 60 min. NO_COMMAND cases excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_60min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30'

panels.title: SLA Breaches (>60 min, cmd fired)
panels.description: Recharges where commands were fired but sync took >60 min.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' AND NOT sla_60min_met AND breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'

panels.title: No Command Fired
panels.description: Recharges where MDMS never sent any command. Excluded from SLA %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' AND breach_reason = 'NO_COMMAND'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(elapsed_seconds)/60.0, 1) AS value FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' AND elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Daily SLA Compliance (Date-wise)
panels.description: SLA % excludes NO_COMMAND rows from denominator. Breach count also excludes NO_COMMAND.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_30min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0), 1) AS "30min_sla_pct", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_60min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0), 1) AS "60min_sla_pct", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT sla_60min_met AND breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND') AS breached, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='NO_COMMAND') AS no_command, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='ALL_FAILED') AS all_failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='PARTIAL_SUCCESS') AS partial, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE balance_cmd_status != 'SUCCESS' AND balance_cmd_status != 'MISSING') AS balance_cmd_failed FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Daily SLA Compliance Trend
panels.description: NO_COMMAND recharges excluded from SLA % denominator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_30min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0), 1) AS "30-Min SLA %", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_60min_met) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND'), 0), 1) AS "60-Min SLA %" FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE(recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='ALL_FAILED') AS "All Cmds Failed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='PARTIAL_SUCCESS' AND NOT sla_60min_met) AS "Partial (slow)", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_reason='NO_COMMAND') AS "No Command Fired" FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: US SET CURRENT BALANCE AMOUNT — Daily Success vs Failure
panels.description: Tracks the specific command targeted by SLA correction

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE balance_cmd_status='SUCCESS') AS "Success", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE balance_cmd_status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','MISSING')) AS "Failed", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE balance_cmd_status='MISSING') AS "Missing" FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time, ROUND(AVG(elapsed_seconds) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL)/60.0, 1) AS "Avg Sync (min)", ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY elapsed_seconds) FILTER (WHERE elapsed_seconds IS NOT NULL)/60.0, 1) AS "p90 Sync (min)" FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SLA Breached Meters — Worst Cases (cmd fired, >60 min)
panels.description: Meters where commands were fired but sync took >60 min. NO_COMMAND cases excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(recharge_created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS date, meter_number, account_id, amount, recharge_created_at, resolved_sync_ts, ROUND(elapsed_seconds/60.0, 1) AS elapsed_min, breach_reason, balance_cmd_status FROM sla_results WHERE recharge_created_at >= '$from_date 00:00:00+05:30' AND recharge_created_at <= '$to_date 23:59:59+05:30' AND NOT sla_60min_met AND breach_reason != 'NO_COMMAND' ORDER BY elapsed_seconds DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 500
